title: The Grade-Six Recipe
summary: At the Weapon Refining Pavilion auction Wang Lin meets Sun Dian, the pavilion master, who is now weaker than him although Wang Lin was only Core Formation when they met two centuries ago, and an old acquaintance, Qiu. He bids a snow-meridian puppet carving for the grade-six Origin Recovery Pill recipe, but someone outbids him. The winner, Zi Xin of the Piaomiao Sect, lures him aside and asks him to find her father, lost in a celestial ruin; Wang Lin just copies the recipe and pays her twenty thousand spirit stones' worth. The recipe needs 137 ingredients, many extinct. He sets the Cloud Sky alchemists working on substitutes and takes the rest himself: a Tuoluo Lotus in Julu, treasures from several sects, and finally Ghost Soul Grass from the Yinyang Sect, guarded by a late Soul Formation elder. He returns just as Wan'er is about to fail.
events: Sun Dian, master of the Weapon Refining Pavilion, recognises Wang Lin
Wang Lin offers a Snow Region puppet carving in the bidding for the grade-six recipe
Zi Xin asks him to find her lost father; he copies the recipe instead
Cloud Sky Sect alchemists search for substitutes for 137 ingredients
Wang Lin seizes a Tuoluo Lotus in Julu and raids several sects
He takes Ghost Soul Grass from the Yinyang Sect
He returns as Wan'er weakens and the pill refining begins
cultivation: Sun Dian is mid Soul Formation. A Tianfan Sect elder is early Soul Formation; a Yinyang Sect protector elder is late Soul Formation.
